mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Fireman's Park, though please be aware of a moderate air quality alert of 63. It is a new moon tonight, and we are expecting an overnight low of 54 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona recently reached a major milestone with the Common Council unanimously adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, focuses on sustainable growth, diverse housing options, and revitalizing our downtown area.

We have plenty to do in town. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, the community is invited to Century School Park for the Puppets in the House international festival, and the Dane County Farmer's Market will also be set up at the State Capitol.
In a noteworthy call from October 3, a 19-year-old Verona man was arrested after officers located him in a vehicle with expired registration, leading to the recovery of a stolen firearm.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The restaurant is currently open, so you have plenty of time to stop by before they close their doors at 10:30 PM tonight.
